label: FlyWire FAFB v783 full neuron set (reference browser export)
anatomy: adult female central brain and optic lobes
source: FlyWire FAFB v783; browser data packaging derived from snedea/flybrain
limitations: The default browser export includes all 139,255 neuron nodes but 2.70 million weighted edges, fewer than the 3.73 million FAFB v783 connections currently reported by Codex. Build/use a current data pack for maximum edge coverage.
FAFB contains the brain, not the complete ventral nerve cord or leg motor system.
The packaged graph contains aggregated neuron-pair connections rather than every individual synaptic cleft.
Sensory transduction and the 2D effector decoder are explicit model interfaces, not reconstructed tissue.
edgeCoverage: 2,698,236 weighted pairs in the referenced browser export; current Codex reports 3,732,460 FAFB v783 connections.
integrity: Pinned Git blob SHA-1 is verified in-browser before decompression for every remote reference asset.
